archetypes.blurb: Cloak, staff, road boots. You have slept under more hedges than roofs.
archetypes.name: Wayfarer

archetypes.blurb: Apron, rolled sleeves, flour to the elbow. You feed people. That is not nothing.
archetypes.name: Hearthkeeper

archetypes.blurb: Tool belt, brass pins, chalk stains. You know what gears sound like when they are wrong.
archetypes.name: Tinker-apprentice
